methodology
methodology · 4 records
  1. Apple often describes quarterly revenue outlook as color rather than formal dollar guidance. Keep exact semantic scope, do not invent ranges for low/mid/high/similar.
  2. Numeric gross-margin guidance is comparable across 12 quarters, but FY26Q3 tariff refunds create an important unforecast one-off.
  3. No annual or multiyear company revenue CAGR guidance verified; do not label an analyst multiyear scenario management guidance.
  4. No credibility multipliers. Positive error means actual exceeds guide midpoint; it is not proof of accurate unbiased demand planning.

limitations

implementation Gates
implementation Gates · 5 records
  1. No default otherClaims=0 or otherAssets=0 may be interpreted as verified absence.
  2. Confirm current cash/debt/shares bridge and consistently classify leases before per-share publication.
  3. Keep SBC as operating cost; reconcile issued shares/outstanding awards and any repurchase assumption without double counting.
  4. A single immediate linear fade cannot represent early annual schedule, cost squeeze and front-loaded investment; use richer model or disclose approximation.
  5. Terminal ROIC and incremental sales/capital must reconcile; no sudden free terminal growth.
interpretation
WACC and terminal parameters are analyst estimates; strong guidance track records do not receive a mechanical credibility uplift.
rationale
rationale · 6 fields
growth
Three-year base 9/8/7% starts below recent16–17% growth and near September9–11% outlook. Services and >2.5bn active devices help; large hardware base, supply constraints and upgrade cyclicality argue against five years at16%. Bull requires durable premium upgrades, Services growth and new products; bear tests stalled hardware cycle.
margin
Current TTM33.17% contains an approximate47bp Q3 refund benefit. September underlying GM46–47% plus rising R&D supports a first-year31% EBIT margin rather than copying current quarterly highs. Recovery toward32% requires memory pressure easing and Services mix.
capital
Owned capex is light but inventory rose and R&D is expensed. Base2.5–3.0x incremental sales/capital charges meaningful investment instead of extrapolating negative net capex or permanent supplier financing.
tax
20% normalized is above recent15–17% reported/quarter guidance, avoids one-time FY24 tax distortion and allows geographic/minimum-tax uncertainty.
terminal
20% marginal ROIC preserves ecosystem advantage but fades far below near-term asset-light accounting returns. Ten-year base maturity,15-year bull and10-year bear are judgments, not product life forecasts.
bridge
Add84.118bn noncurrent securities only once if non-operating and available; exact June term debt+CP84.344bn. Annual lease figures stale; current awards/dilution still require policy. Net-cash-neutral target retired April30, so no forced buyback path.
invalidators
invalidators · 6 records
  1. Two successive reported quarters materially below latest revenue outlook with weak Services or upgrade demand
  2. Underlying gross margin below46% after refunds fade, without evidence of temporary component timing
  3. Sustained Services growth below high-single digits or legal changes materially alter distribution/search economics
  4. Inventory growth materially exceeds sales and later write-downs or channel discounting appear
  5. R&D/AI serving costs rise without retention, revenue or pricing benefits
  6. No supply recovery while premium-device demand or China competitiveness deteriorates

assistant judgment / educational default
summary
A mature hardware franchise with recurring services: moderate expansion, durable margins and relatively light incremental capital needs.
assumptions
assumptions · 10 fields
growth
0.08
target Margin
0.32

0.2
sales Capital
3
wacc
0.09
terminal Growth
0.025

0.2
years
10
other Claims

other Assets

rationale
rationale · 10 fields
growth
8% starts above FY2025 growth of 6.4% but below the latest 16% quarter. Services and replacement demand support growth; the installed base and hardware maturity argue for an immediate fade rather than extrapolating one strong quarter.
target Margin
32% is close to FY2025 operating margin and below the current 33.2% TTM. Services mix offsets hardware competition; the latest tariff-refund benefit is not assumed permanent.
tax
20% is a normalized blended cash-tax judgment above FY2025 accounting tax of 15.6%; one-off tax charges, geographic mix and minimum-tax changes make any single reported rate a weak long-run anchor.
sales Capital
3.0x requires about $0.33 of net reinvestment for each extra $1 of revenue. Outsourced manufacturing and services justify lighter capital needs; this is not the inflated book return created by buybacks or a claim that working capital is free.
terminal ROIC
20% retains a brand/ecosystem advantage but materially reduces returns on new capital from the explicit-period margin/capital combination.
wacc
9.0% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.0, modest 10% target debt and a 0.7-point debt spread reflect broad cash generation, balanced against product concentration and supply-chain exposure.
terminal Growth
2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
years
10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
other Claims
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not evidence that no additional claims exist. Long-dated securities, leases and employee awards need a consistent enterprise-to-common-equity reconciliation; zero additional assets does not mean the securities are worthless.
other Assets
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not a statement that all non-operating assets are absent or worthless. Review assets not already included in snapshot cash and avoid double counting.
